Name: Test the population
Statement: Audit tests run on all transactions, not a sample.
Rationale: Sampling misses rare but costly events.

Name: Evidence by default
Statement: Every test result is kept with run, rule version and links.
Rationale: Auditors rely on evidence, not memory.
Implications: Retain results outside the mining tool.

Name: Read-only, minimum data
Statement: Extract only the tables and fields the tests need, read-only.
Rationale: Reduces risk and load on the source.
Implications: Field list per test; no write-back.

Name: Mask before load
Statement: Personal identifiers are pseudonymised before leaving the source domain.
Implications: Key stays with the source team.

Name: Standard first
Statement: Use the standard suite features before custom code.
Implications: Custom code only where a gap is shown.

Name: Object-centric by default
Statement: Model P2P as linked objects, not one forced case ID.
Implications: Keep an object and relationship dictionary.

Name: Tests as configuration
Statement: Control tests are versioned configuration with an owner.
Rationale: Tests change often; audits need history.

Name: Assist, never decide
Statement: AI suggests; a person decides and records the cause.
Implications: Human step on every deviation; log AI use.

Name: No beta in the critical path
Statement: Beta and roadmap features are optional add-ons.

Name: Region and reports first
Statement: Confirm hosting region and attestation reports before data moves.
